overview: Surgical technologists prepare operating rooms, set up sterile instruments and hand tools to surgeons during procedures. They count sponges and needles before and after each case and keep the sterile field intact. O*NET rates monitoring at 3.62 out of 5 for this job and knowledge of medicine at 4.12. Most complete a certificate or associate degree program in surgical technology. The BLS May 2025 median is $64,650 across 117,460 jobs. The job means long hours on your feet indoors, close teamwork and exposure to infection, and the details really matter.
pay: Surgical technologists earn a median of $64,650, and the top 10% earn $96,940 or more. Hawaii, Oregon and California have the highest state medians, from $81,310 to $82,640, or 26% to 28% above the national figure. California also has the most jobs, 11,920, followed by Texas with 10,160.

faq.q: How much do surgical technologists make?
faq.a: The BLS May 2025 median is $64,650 a year. The middle half earn between $54,690 and $79,750. Hawaii pays the most at $82,640, while Alabama ($49,420) and West Virginia ($49,110) have the lowest state medians. Overtime and on-call shifts often add to pay.

faq.q: How long does it take to become a surgical technologist?
faq.a: Most programs take 1 to 2 years and lead to a certificate or associate degree. O*NET places the job in Job Zone 3. Many employers prefer certification as a CST (Certified Surgical Technologist), which needs an accredited program and a national exam.

faq.q: Is surgical technology a hard job?
faq.a: It is physically demanding. In O*NET data the job ranks above 99% of U.S. jobs for working with people and above 90% for time on your feet. You follow strict sterile rules, and mistakes can have serious consequences. Cautiousness and attention to detail stand out as work styles.

faq.q: What can surgical technologists do next?
faq.a: Surgical Assistants are an 82% match and earn $66,800, 3% more. Radiation Therapists are also an 82% match and earn $105,310, 63% more, according to BLS May 2025 data, after an associate degree program. Respiratory therapy is a 77% match.
